links.outcome: Presence of coordinated, accountable AI governance structures at academic medical centers
links.effect: Three governance phenotypes found (well-defined, emerging, interpersonal); in interpersonal systems an individual decides on model implementation without consistent evaluation requirements; even well-resourced AMCs struggled to manage pitfalls.
links.quote: In health systems using interpersonal or individual-driven governance approaches, an individual is tasked with making decisions about model implementation without consistent evaluation requirements.

unlisted_practices: Multilevel governance that includes industry and regulators rather than concentrating responsibility within health systems

screen.reason: Qualitative empirical interview study characterizing organizational governance phenotypes and practices for AI predictive risk models across 13 US academic medical centers.
